caption: The video captures a high-speed view against a blurred, dark forest background. A spherical puff of pale powder hangs on the right, held by a thin black rod, with a fixed red marker dot on the holder. An orange-red ignition front appears as a thin crescent on the cloud's left and thickens into a bright vertical flame column with a yellow-orange core. The pale cloud expands and diffuses outward, becoming larger and wispier while staying near its original spot. A bullet-shaped object, initially embedded in the cloud, moves steadily leftward, emerging from the powder into the open background on the left. The red dot on the holder stays fixed, distinguishing it from the moving projectile. The glowing column and dispersing cloud persist, the process still underway.
